name: MIKROMB
recent: Mikro MSC 于2026年11月19日完成以RM30百万全股票收购Broadguard Sdn Bhd，并发行51,724,138股新股。同期，执行董事Yim Yuen Wah在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。公司最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收与净利均实现环比和同比增长。
notable: 完成以RM30百万全股票收购Broadguard Sdn Bhd 100%股权，并发行51,724,138股新股。
执行董事Yim Yuen Wah在2026年11月3日、23日及24日于闭市期间合计增持37,700,000股。
2026年11月2日宣布三名主要管理人员变动。
risks: 收购Broadguard以发行新股支付，导致现有股东股权被摊薄。
执行董事在闭市期间增持股份，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为RM20.35百万，环比增长15.9%，同比增长3.9%；净利为RM4.91百万，环比增长23.3%，同比增长58.0%，净利率为24.1%。

recent_en: Mikro MSC completed the RM30 million all-share acquisition of Broadguard Sdn Bhd on 19 November 2026, issuing 51,724,138 new shares. Meanwhile, Executive Director Yim Yuen Wah acquired shares multiple times during the closed period. The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw revenue and net profit grow both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Completed the RM30 million all-share acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd, issuing 51,724,138 new shares.
Executive Director Yim Yuen Wah acquired a total of 37,700,000 shares during the closed period on 3, 23 and 24 November 2026.
Announced changes to three principal officers on 2 November 2026.
risks_en: The acquisition of Broadguard was satisfied via new share issuance, diluting existing shareholders.
The Executive Director increased his shareholding during the closed period; further changes in shareholding should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.35 million, up 15.9% QoQ and 3.9% YoY; net profit was RM4.91 million, up 23.3% QoQ and 58.0% YoY, with a net margin of 24.1%.
